decision.direction_statement: Introduce a public-safe evaluation protocol for object-aligned multimodal retrieval-augmented generation using a locked 48-query, 24-suite matrix to compare retrieval and answer-grounding variants, report uncertainty, and characterize object-level citation-grounding failures.
decision.non_claim: Do not claim that evidence_unit_verified significantly improves citation precision over evidence_unit_candidate under the fixed go criterion.

claim_matrix_draft.avoid_claim: The method improves retrieval-answer performance across the benchmark.
claim_matrix_draft.replacement_claim: The locked matrix executes a complete 24-suite by 9-variant evaluation protocol with no skipped variants.

claim_matrix_draft.avoid_claim: Verified object evidence significantly improves citation precision over candidate evidence.
claim_matrix_draft.replacement_claim: Candidate and verified evidence-unit variants are comparable baselines whose paired deltas quantify uncertainty and failure modes.

claim_matrix_draft.avoid_claim: The system is paper-ready for aggregate performance claims.
claim_matrix_draft.replacement_claim: The failed regression gate identifies a benchmark stress case and motivates failure-taxonomy reporting.
Object-aligned verification defines an auditable protocol for separating candidate visual support, verified links, and citation grounding.

claim_matrix_draft.avoid_claim: The paper can release full examples and evidence traces.
claim_matrix_draft.replacement_claim: The benchmark report can release aggregate metrics, artifact names, schema metadata, reason-code counts, and exclusion rules without private payload text.

claim_matrix_draft.avoid_claim: Deterministic verifier outputs are final human/VLM-validated labels.
claim_matrix_draft.replacement_claim: Deterministic verifier outputs are first-pass benchmark labels; #281 human audit and real VLM smoke remain required before stronger annotation-quality claims.

reusable_artifacts.benchmark_use: No-go decision, fixed criteria, quality-gate failure, and transition rationale.
Reason codes, thresholds, bootstrap settings, and follow-up issue link.
Convert blocked performance claims into benchmark/protocol claims.
Matrix coverage, semantic smoke evidence, privacy coverage, and quality-gate gap.
Reusable artifact filenames and current statuses.
Variant-level aggregate means and uncertainty protocol.
Failed metrics as benchmark stress cases.
Reason-code counts and variant aggregate metrics.
Compact aggregate table for manual inspection.
Commands, dataset descriptor counts, and privacy policy metadata.

failure_taxonomy_summary.interpretation: Retrieval misses dominate, while insufficient evidence and unsupported claims remain distinct answer-grounding risks.

risks_and_limitations.risk: #281 human audit and real VLM smoke are incomplete.
risks_and_limitations.paper_impact: Deterministic verifier labels should be described as first-pass protocol labels rather than final human/VLM-validated annotations.

risks_and_limitations.risk: The expanded query set was not available for the no-go decision.
risks_and_limitations.paper_impact: Claims should be scoped to the locked 48-query matrix.

risks_and_limitations.risk: The regression gate failed on a stress case.
risks_and_limitations.paper_impact: Use the failure as benchmark evidence and a readiness blocker, not as a passed aggregate result.

risks_and_limitations.risk: The candidate-to-verified citation-precision delta did not meet the fixed significance criterion.
risks_and_limitations.paper_impact: Do not frame verified object alignment as a demonstrated performance improvement.
